column3: The Hebrew explicitly names all his inward parts; BSB says all that is within me.
The Hebrew has a singular iniquity; BSB has iniquities.
The Hebrew names his adornment as what is satisfied; BSB simply says satisfies you.
The Hebrew has plural righteousnesses and judgments; BSB has singular righteousness and justice.
The Hebrew calls the Israelites sons of Israel; BSB says people of Israel.
The Hebrew leaves the objects of accusing and keeping unspecified; BSB supplies us and His anger.
The Hebrew names sons without an explicit his; BSB says his children.
The Hebrew says its place will not recognize it; BSB says remembers it no more.
The Hebrew repeats word and has no explicit all before angels; BSB adds all and varies word and command.
